visualRevision: The accepted aligned composition is retained. Pending recipient sectors now use the existing vivid blue instead of red, still fading to gray over 650 ms after enqueue. Msg transport to Digest takes 480 ms instead of 600 ms (1.25x speed); other timing is unchanged. The movement arrow is restored to the character movement centerline (world.y + 126), correcting its previous 27 px upward offset. Character sizes, packet selection and enqueue behavior remain the same.
composition: One 3x3 viewport contains the moving A and top-row S1, S2, S3. Each recipient has an overhead preview of the number of Msgs it must receive. The center remains a reusable raw Digest; the right components remain separate SendQs. Original source-sector storage is internal to the model and is not drawn.
semanticRules: Packets are stored in the sector where the event originated
Each receiving sector chooses its own neighboring source-sector packets
Packet order follows source-sector row and column order, then order within a sector
Original headers and payloads are concatenated without adding a new wire-level header
The reusable temporary buffer is cleared and rebuilt for each receiving sector
Original source packets remain available while other receiving sectors are processed
One RequestSendRaw per resident; several residents in the same sector would use the same completed Digest bytes
The displayed grid is a viewport; valid neighborhoods can extend beyond its edges
limits: This after draft uses four events to make accumulation visible; the preceding before draft shows one event, so they are not yet a matched numerical A/B example
Membership digest, global cleanup, Msg allocation and later WSASend execution are outside this drawing
Only completed source packet generation is illustrated; dirty coordinate aggregation is not changed
visualBasis: Verified Figure 3 character vectors and navy PCB palette, orthogonal 1.5px traces, flat recipient Msg previews, data-only emphasis
